Topics covered in this PDF

BRL-001 (Overview of Retailing) - the questions solved in this PDF are on these topics:

  • Challenges faced by Indian retailers, cultural and social factors in consumer behaviour, sourcing, financial management in retailing, GST
  • Technology in retailing, rural markets, cash and carry, retail careers, business ethics

These topics are taken from the questions in this PDF. Check the official syllabus and assignment paper for your session with IGNOU.

Assignment pattern

As printed on the first page of the PDF:

  • The cover prints: attempt all questions, maximum marks 100, coverage all blocks, assignment code BRL-001/TMA/2026-27. Part A: short type questions (10 marks each unless printed otherwise). Part B: two essay type questions of 15 marks each
  • Question 4 carries 5+5 marks and Question 9 carries 8+7 marks, as printed

Always check your session's assignment paper and submission deadline on the official IGNOU website or with your study centre.
